acceptance: LakeSail's default container limit is evidenced at the largest gated scale or removed.
CI and the default agree, or the owner approved the difference.
context: Filed 2026-11-20 from the adversarial review of the scale-factor and TPC-DI remediation work (PRs #4298-#4385 and benchbox-site #178-#210).
description:
## Problem
Before #4340 LakeSail had no memory limit under Docker. #4340 adds a 4g default in docker/lakesail/docker-compose.yml for every engine and describes it as a limit mocker previously ignored. trunk-uat.yml and release-v2.yml set LAKESAIL_MEMORY_LIMIT to 12g, so CI certifies 12g while users get 4g, and nothing tests 4g at SF 1. The 12g shard has never run (the probe dispatch fails with HTTP 403). The guardrail on doris-tpcds-obt-results-capped-parallelism-20261111 says never to silently change UAT container limits.

## Change
Run LakeSail TPC-DS-OBT at SF 1 with the 4g default through `make uat-cell` or `make heavy-run` and record peak memory and outcome. Then either keep 4g with that evidence and make CI test the same value, or remove the new default. Correct the changelog and spec wording to say a limit was added.

## Decision gates
The owner chooses keep-4g-with-evidence, another value, or no default, after seeing the SF 1 result. CI and the user default must not differ without a stated reason the owner accepts.

## Verification rubric
Pass: the SF 1 run's bundle, mem trace and command are recorded; the compose default, both workflows, the provisioning table and the changelog state the same facts; a stage-2 CI run with the chosen value is linked, after #4340 merges develop (which carries the probe dispatch fix); memory headroom for 12g on ubuntu-latest is checked.

## Guardrails
- Any limit, default, threshold or label id or text is shown to the owner before it is committed. Briefs quote owner answers verbatim; questions to the owner carry no preselected answer.
- The implementer replies on review threads and leaves resolving them to the reviewer or the owner, unless the owner says otherwise (AGENTS.md asks agents to resolve benchbox-oracle threads on soundness paths; the owner has been asked which applies).
- Hosted writes (merge, close, disable or enable auto-merge, workflow dispatch, remote branch delete) only as the repository's close-out procedure or the owner's word for that pull request allows; never raw `gh pr merge` in core.
- No polling loop around `make pr-arm`, no `--no-verify`, no stand-in review unless the owner names the PR and head unprompted. Push only after `make pr-preflight` exits 0 on the exact head.
- No worktree takeover while another session may be working; no tracker write from a server that reports a stale version; never chain `git stash` with `git stash pop`.
- Heavy work runs only through `make heavy-run` or a lock-taking entry point, one run at a time.
- Status reports state only what merged and what was verified, with the evidence.
